fusions.name: Barbed Harpoon
fusions.desc: Fires a reef-barbed bolt at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, knocks it back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Staghorn Burst
fusions.desc: Fires 3 reef shards in a spread, each dealing 4 water damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Grown Battery
fusions.desc: Grows a reef battery that stands for 15 seconds and fires at an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 water damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Encrusted Scope
fusions.desc: Conjures a reef-grown scope for your weapon: your critical hit chance rises by 6%, your critical damage multiplier rises by 0.15, and each kill restores 2 health.
